targets.rawSql: SELECT date AS time, temp_anomaly_c AS "anomaly_c" FROM climate.fact_temperature WHERE country_id = 0 ORDER BY date
SELECT date AS time, co2_ppm AS "co2_ppm" FROM climate.fact_co2_atmospheric ORDER BY date

SELECT toDateTime(concat(toString(e.year),'-01-01 00:00:00')) AS time, c.income_group AS metric, sum(e.co2_mt) AS value FROM climate.fact_emissions_co2 AS e INNER JOIN climate.dim_country AS c ON e.country_id = c.country_id WHERE e.source_id = 1 AND c.income_group != 'Aggregate' GROUP BY time, metric ORDER BY time

panels.title: Renewable share of energy by region (%)

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(concat(toString(en.year),'-01-01 00:00:00')) AS time, c.region AS metric, round(avg(en.renewables_share_pct),1) AS value FROM climate.fact_energy AS en INNER JOIN climate.dim_country AS c ON en.country_id = c.country_id WHERE en.year >= 1990 GROUP BY time, metric ORDER BY time

SELECT c.country_name AS country, c.income_group, round(max(e.cumulative_co2_mt)/1000,1) AS cumulative_gt_co2 FROM climate.fact_emissions_co2 AS e INNER JOIN climate.dim_country AS c ON e.country_id = c.country_id WHERE e.source_id = 1 GROUP BY country, c.income_group ORDER BY cumulative_gt_co2 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Disaster deaths by decade & income group

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(concat(toString(d.decade),'-01-01 00:00:00')) AS time, c.income_group AS metric, sum(d.deaths) AS value FROM climate.agg_disasters_by_type_decade AS d INNER JOIN climate.dim_country AS c ON d.country_id = c.country_id WHERE c.income_group != 'Aggregate' GROUP BY time, metric ORDER BY time
SELECT date AS time, gmsl_mm AS "gmsl_mm" FROM climate.fact_sea_level ORDER BY date

panels.title: CO₂ per capita by income group (t)

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(concat(toString(e.year),'-01-01 00:00:00')) AS time, c.income_group AS metric, round(avg(e.co2_per_capita_t),2) AS value FROM climate.fact_emissions_co2 AS e INNER JOIN climate.dim_country AS c ON e.country_id = c.country_id WHERE e.source_id = 1 AND e.year >= 1970 AND c.income_group != 'Aggregate' GROUP BY time, metric ORDER BY time

panels.title: Climate vulnerability vs disaster damage by income group

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.income_group, round(avg(v.nd_gain_index),1) AS avg_nd_gain, round(avg(v.vulnerability),3) AS avg_vulnerability, round(sum(d.total_damage_usd_k)/1e6,1) AS total_damage_bn_usd, sum(d.total_deaths) AS total_deaths FROM climate.fact_disasters AS d INNER JOIN climate.dim_country AS c ON d.country_id = c.country_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT country_id, avg(nd_gain_index) nd_gain_index, avg(vulnerability) vulnerability FROM climate.fact_vulnerability GROUP BY country_id) AS v ON d.country_id = v.country_id WHERE d.year >= 2000 GROUP BY c.income_group ORDER BY total_damage_bn_usd DESC
